Episode 246: The Battle for the Mitra Desert (18)
Kwaaaaaa-!
The main cannon of Pibil once again struck the dimensional gate.
Jin flinched, eyeing the red plutonian artillery that scattered radially upon colliding with the dimensional gate.
If Teto and Garmund were emerging from Lafrarosa like the previous two kings, they were at risk of directly taking the impact of the undeterred Red Plutonian artillery.
However, Beliz and Linpa remained unfazed, unlike Jin.

"If the Teto and Garmund brothers are coming out of the rift, the Sister Goddess of Battle must have lent her power again. So don't worry too much, Brother Jin. No matter how powerful that damned weapon is, do you think it could penetrate the energy of the Battle God?"
As such, the main cannon of Pibill couldn't make a direct hit inside the passageway but scattered radially because it collided with the energy of Vahn.
A ferocious energy burst forth, tearing through the dimensional rift. The energy spread like a fog, pushing away the Red's energy waves.
The crack from which the energy emerged was quickly widening. It seemed as if a gigantic hand was gripping the rift with malice.
'Beliz is right. Moreover, both Teto and Garmund are Battle King’s. They can endure this.'
The Red Plutonian seemed to have made the same assumption.

The combat prowess of the Battle King’s was already proven by Beliz and Linpa, and the power of the Battle God goes without saying, so the air fortress and fleet were continuously increasing their output.
Fzzt, Fwaaaah-!
Sword energy poured from Sigmund and the Battle King’s. The strands of fierce energy assisted Jin's thunderbolt, rushing towards the front of Pibil.
Normally, Pibil wouldn't need to raise a separate protective shield to counteract the trio's attack.
Because the two aerial fortresses, Rital and Vesel, excluding Patlok who was concentrating on tracking through subspace, would provide cover.
However, Luna and Dante were already attacking Rital, and the second group was approaching Vesel.
Thus, Pibil hastily shifted the energy from its main cannon to its protective shield, bracing for the trio's attackers.
"Shimat! Are you going to hide in the aerial fortress this time too? Come out, you bastard. I'm curious to see how you, named Genesis, compare to our Sister Goddess of Battle!"

After releasing her sword energy, Beliz was the first to approach Pibil's shield, swinging her greatsword directly at it. Using just her toes' strength, she grasped the shield and swung her greatsword like a hammer.
Linpa cleared the path by deflecting incoming artillery, while Jin moved closer to the rift to sense the energy of the brothers he just mentioned.
The energies of Teto and Garmund were intensifying rapidly. It seemed as if they could almost see Vahn protecting them beyond the passageway.
Soon after, two figures of the Plutonian revealed themselves from between the dimensional passageways.
"Khaaaah!"
"Cough!"
As soon as they emerged from the dimension, Teto and Garmund screamed in pain.
"Brothers Teto, Brothers Garmund!"
Both were in bad shape. Even from a distance, one could feel the energy from their cores rotating unstably.
"Keke, kyakya, khak! Cough! Brother Jin!"
"Oh, Jin, cough!"
However, Teto and Garmund, despite coughing up blood, waved happily at Jin.
Teto even let out his characteristic frivolous laughter, but Jin quickly stepped towards his brothers, gritting his teeth.
Another shot from the air fortress was close.
Swoosh-!
Fortunately, Jin stood in front just in time to swing Sigmund before the shot from the fortress hit the ground.
The split projectile missed Jin and the brothers, falling towards the trio of demons.
"Brothers, what on earth...!"
Beliz and Linpa, arriving late, quickly assessed the brothers' condition and narrowed their eyes.
Garmund and Teto had been injured from the pressure of dimensional break and external attacks from within Lafrarosa.
In particular, the Red Sea unleashed by Shimat during the last battle caused the most significant damage.
It was fortunate for the Plutonian that the passage suddenly closed, preventing the technique from continuing.
"Ah! The coughing has finally stopped. We're not hurt from that recent shot. It's so good to see you, Brother Jin. Kyakya."
"Brothers Beliz and Linpa are there too! And finally, we get to see the unidentified jerks who've been attacking us..."
Teto and Garmund scanned the battlefield with a smirk. It was the first time they had seen their enemies.
"Brothers, how is Lafrarosa now? Are the other brothers okay?"
"To be honest, many brothers are hurt. We're almost under a one-sided attack from beyond the dimension. Even without that, many brothers are collapsing because of the dimension errors."
"But for now, thanks to the Battle God Brothers, we're holding on!"

"It's all because Brother Jin tried to free us. Hmm! But we'll have to save the long story for later. Those damned ones are firing their cannons. And those demons? Are they our enemies? Their attacks seem ineffective, strangely."
"They will eventually become enemies, but for now, they are closer to allies."
The three dodged the artillery shots. Jin briefly explained the current situation to Teto and Garmund.
"...I see! We need to throw the liberation device through the passage to Lafrarosa."
"Is it possible? Brother Garmund."
"Hmm, the protective barrier of the God Brother is so vast... Even if it's the God Brother, it seems difficult to visually identify that object."

"Moreover, looking at it now, the passage you mentioned isn’t a straight line. Those Red Plutonian mainly attack the sides of the rift. If the passage was straight, our attacks wouldn’t be as erratic. Sometimes a red surge even came up from the ground."
It was all content discussed in the meeting.
However, the fact that the passage leads to the 'random space' inside Lafrarosa means, conversely, that the device can suddenly appear right before the eyes of the Plutonian.
Without even passing through Vahn's protective barrier.
[Huh? Look at this, just as Margiella said. Those guys, they haven’t done anything directly yet, but more Battle King’s have been summoned, right?]
[Indeed, Stribi. Orgal still seems to be in his right mind, making a wise decision.]
Passing by, Stribi and Karmash commented upon seeing the Battle Kings.
Meanwhile, Pibil took another aim at Jin, but Jin expanded the streak of lightning on his sword into a golden thunder, slightly twisting the trajectory of the shot.
He neutralized the attack using a relatively much weaker force.
It was a skill he had learned from recent frequent battles with the air fortress.
"Whoa? What's that golden energy? Teach me too!"
Teto immediately said the same thing as Beliz, and Garmund looked at Jin with a pleased and admiring face.
"By the way, our brother Jin! In that short time, you've reached the pinnacle of martial arts. Clearly, you are now the King’s Sword."
Garmund and Teto were quickly regaining their breath and stabilizing.
Not exactly healing from external wounds as if they had rapid regeneration, but the surge that was once shaking unstably in their hearts now seemed to have firmly found its center.
It felt as if they were 'resonating with Battle God'.
Both Teto and Garmund, and Jin felt it.
"Haha! Being next to brother Jin feels like when I resonate with the Sister Goddess of Battle, I feel so full of energy inside!"
"It must be that Jin naturally acquired the resonance when he merged with Battle God."
The surges on Teto's spear and Garmund's greatsword began to emit a deeper blue light.
It was hard to believe that these were the same people who had been vomiting blood just moments ago. A strong and majestic aura was erupting from them.
In response, the air fortresses also increased the intensity of their energy wave, and the warships swiftly moved, showering the ground with their cannons.
Teto and Garmund smiled slyly.

"Even with the five Battle Kings, they don't get intimidated! When I was inside, I just thought they were just treacherous caln, but face to face, they are formidable foes. But as the Battle God Brothers vowed, in the end, you will become extinct!”
"Come at us, you bastard!"
As Garmund and Teto leaped, Linpa and Beliz moved closer to them, clearing the way.
Jin, unlike his brothers, didn't leap onto the fleet directly but settled on the ground.
It's obvious that the Battle Kings move much more, but Jin was clearly the center of it all.
Golden Thunder Sword Technique - Golden Clouds
Following the trajectory of the leaping Great Kings, golden orbs formed.
There were more than thirty in an instant.
Each was roughly the size of a Red Plutonian ship, but the orbs did not hinder the brothers' path at all.
The brothers also saw the Golden Thunder Technique - Golden Clouds as a familiar sword, effortlessly hurling themselves between the orbs.
The golden thunder emanating from the orbs narrowly missed the brothers but never struck them.
It only struck down the Red’s shields.
When the Golden Clouds caused cracks in the shields, the brothers inserted their weapons into those cracks.
For the Red Plutonian, because of the sudden addition of two Battle Kings, they had no choice but to focus all their power towards Jin.
The joining of Garmund and Teto was not just the addition of two superhumans; it was the addition of two people who could fight seamlessly, in perfect unity like one body.
The heirs of Battle God mean having the same rank as when Vahn is absent.
Until the Battle Kings' Great War, it was merely a title.
But now, Jin possesses the ability to truly fill the void of the Battle God.
Directing the clan on the front line, without anything amiss.
Golden Thunder Sword Technique - Sky Splitter First Form
The moment Jin swung his sword towards the sky, the brothers immediately split to the left and right.
A massive golden sword energy erupted between them, sweeping away the enemy fleet.
Shields already damaged by the Golden Clouds and the attacks of the Battle Kings couldn't protect the fleet.
Some ships quickly evaded, sticking closely to the aerial fortress, but most were covered by the sword energy and exploded.
Yet, the Sky Splitter First Form did not lose momentum and went straight towards Pibil.
In the end, Shimat had to come out again and personally unleash his Sky Divine/Heavenly Sword, which was exactly what Jin wanted.
Drawing him out of the aerial fortress meant that the third group could more easily move the device.
"Hee, Mr. Owl. When the red-skinned leader is fully distracted by Jin, we must move quickly. Let's go now!"
